items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: But yeah, he played with that band.

ctx.x: Bunk was in there for a while, too.

Yeah, that's right. That's how Bunk got... When Bunk quit playing music, he went back down there and worked at a place where they made tabasco sauce, in New Iberia. But yeah, he played with that band.
Were bands like the Banner Band and Clayborn Williams famous bands in Baton Rouge?
